title: The Fun Doesn’t End with Summer at L.A.’s Year-Round Pools
description:
The fun doesn’t end with summer! The Van Nuys–Sherman Oaks Pool is one of several City of Los Angeles pools open year-round, offering residents opportunities to swim and participate in aquatic programs throughout the fall and winter.

Van Nuys residents closed out the summer with a splash at a lively pool party featuring free games, aquatic activities, and family fun. The celebration capped off a busy summer season filled with programs for swimmers of all ages and skill levels—from young children learning water-safety basics to teens competing in water polo.

Ready to keep making waves? Find a City of Los Angeles year-round pool near you:
https://recreation.parks.lacity.gov/aquatic/year-round
